premises.text: Robotic arms should expand beyond factory car assembly to many applications
premises.evidence_span: when you think about robotic arms, you probably picture a factory, probably assembling cars. But robotic arms can be used for so much more

premises.text: Casio is priced like a laptop while matching industrial capability
premises.evidence_span: Casio has the capabilities of an industrial arm, but the price of a laptop

premises.text: Hardware delivers kilogram-scale reach, sub-mm precision, carbon fiber, and strong onboard compute
premises.evidence_span: Cassia can move over one kilogram anywhere within a one-meter work envelope with sub-millimeter precision. She has a carbon fiber frame, brushless DC muscles, and more raw processing power than most of the computers in this room

premises.text: End-effector swapping makes the arm infinitely customizable
premises.evidence_span: Casio is infinitely customizable. You can transform Casio into a completely different tool just by swapping the attachments at the end

premises.text: Training requires no advanced degree—guide-and-playback or consumer devices suffice
premises.evidence_span: You generally need an advanced degree just to get started. We've made Casio incredibly easy to train

premises.text: Built-in whole-surface human proximity sensing makes the arm safe around people
premises.evidence_span: We've built this into every surface of Cassia's housing. This makes her the safest robustic arm that has ever been made

premises.text: Sub-$5,000 pricing is the adoption tipping point across industries
premises.evidence_span: a sub $5,000 arm is the holy grail of robotics. This is the tipping point where massive adoption across a range of industries becomes inevitable

premises.text: API developer platform removes hardware-skill barriers for builders
premises.evidence_span: Our APIs cut the complexity, so if you can build a website, you can code for Cassia

value.text: Democratized personal robotic arms for makers and new applications
value.evidence_span: tools that are industrial and expensive becoming personal, ubiquitous, democratized

causal_links.evidence_span: Casio has the capabilities of an industrial arm, but the price of a laptop
you don't need any special skills to get started
we've made Cassia a developer platform
